content: HC API: reads limited to past 30 days of other apps' data unless PERMISSION_READ_HEALTH_DATA_HISTORY granted; background reads need READ_HEALTH_DATA_IN_BACKGROUND + FEATURE_READ_HEALTH_DATA_IN_BACKGROUND availability check; rate limits are periodic+daily, stricter in background; recommended pattern is changelog sync (getChangesToken/getChanges) not repeated raw range reads; HC built into Android 14+, separate installable APK on 13-, availability must be runtime-checked via HealthConnectClient.getSdkStatus; Record.metadata.dataOrigin carries source package for provenance.
